title: campanula cochleariifolia var. foudrasii
intro: Campanula cochleariifolia var. foudrasii, commonly known as Foudras' bellflower, is a plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Foudras' bellflower include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety, and promote sleep. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
